Sub: Grant of exemption from the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 u/s.

Sir,

On scrutiny of the proposals received from the Addl. CPFCs (Zones), it has
been observed that in a large number of cases the exemption from EDLI Scheme,
1976 u/s 17(2A) of the Act is being recommended from retrospective date ranging
to many years. From the said proposals it appears that the default in EDLI Scheme

or the proposals for relaxation / exemption from EDLI Scheme are not being
monitored effectively.

In view of the above, all the RPFCs-I are advised to send the following
